description: This file defines an AppError struct and related functions for handling and creating API error responses in a Go project, specific to an operator module in an Android Cuttlefish frontend project.

classes.name: AppError
classes.description: Custom error type for API errors, including message, status code, and underlying error.

methods.name: Error
methods.description: Returns the error message, including underlying error if present.

methods.name: JSONResponse
methods.description: Returns an API-specific error message structure for JSON responses.
